# Competitive Signal Report — Enterprise AI Platform (Thursday, 03 September 2026)

> **Bottom line:** Competitors are doubling down on agentic orchestration and AI agent capabilities, with Genesys and Salesforce highlighting their platform integrations. Kore.ai's proven analyst leadership in conversational AI for CX, coupled with its deterministic ABL and true omnichannel capabilities, remains the key differentiator against these evolving, but often platform-bound or narrowly focused, offerings.

## Three signals that matter
### Genesys Orchestrates AI Agents and Journeys
**What happened —** Genesys unveiled its AI control plane and agentic orchestration stack at Xperience 2026 and announced new AI tools to orchestrate customer journeys. Genesys also expanded its ecosystem for trusted enterprise agentic experience orchestration. ([TechTarget](https://news.google.?oc=5), [IT Brief Australia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxOempLd1h3VVJhYUNZYjlWV1RrX2RNY3Z2Q00tT2ktVkN1OU9CRHdlclk1MkFVWVpiYmtZOU4yM3luZVRRZjZYZGlfejZEY2pHYjJaRVBiSnByVzNKa2c4dDNFcHh2cHNFUEEzaEFjZzlwNWVKZ3pGVldLVUxSdkFLZVJLNEM3aWprSDhoTEJ6UQ?oc=5), [Business Wire](https://news.google.?oc=5), [CX Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPMjhTTllIMlgxT093MlloeXBCVjZ1R2lDOVFBblpkd0NlZjB5cnFZSTZSdUNuREpSM2NNcUhTamphQ3lmbEY1X1ZBTWwyMk1zeXRtRlg1M041eDJnOG1QeklKbFowX1NjbC13aVo5UjFhZGh1UlFmaWo5UVVyUTFTcFNNQVpDak9OTnl0bg?oc=5))
**What it means for Kore.ai —** This reinforces Genesys's strategy of layering AI onto its CCaaS foundation, a move that Kore.ai counters by emphasizing its purpose-built, AI-native platform with superior orchestration and deterministic control, as recognized by Gartner and Forrester.

### Salesforce Agentforce Expands Enterprise Workflow Capabilities
**What happened —** Salesforce announced that Agentforce Winter '27 will enable AI agents to run full enterprise workflows in production, building on its existing Agentforce and Claudeforce capabilities. Smarsh also reported scaling Salesforce's Agentforce after achieving strong customer support results. ([Tech Times](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Business Wire](https://news.google.?oc=5), [Atrium AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE9HcEhKdVREUHUxOTBvVHZOUC1SRS1UbHZXaTY0MVFQUHRlYlhvcTBUM1J4dm5Xbk1NdWdDTnk1Uk9PdDBmNnZrYmJTU0c4VXNWZFBHQ0N3QTZvcUxlYVp4b09STHlzcmp6Wl9oVU14ZlFic1JjYzE4?oc=5))
**What it means for Kore.ai —** Salesforce's push into full enterprise workflows with Agentforce highlights the increasing complexity of agentic AI deployments. Kore.ai's ABL provides compile-time validation and deterministic execution for these complex workflows, a critical advantage over Salesforce's more fluid, potentially less auditable approach.

### Glean Positions AI Search as Cost-Saving Work AI
**What happened —** Glean is positioning its AI search and "Work AI" as a cost-saving measure, claiming its tokens are 70% cheaper than Claude CoWork and that customers' bills can be 80% higher than necessary. The CPOs of Harvey, Glean, and Rubrik discussed shipping category-winning agents. ## Watch for
- Continued integration and positioning of acquired technologies by NICE (Cognigy) and ServiceNow (Moveworks).
- Further announcements from Sierra regarding enterprise customer adoption and analyst validation.
- Any shifts in pricing models from Salesforce Agentforce as they mature their offering.

## Recommended actions
- **Amplify analyst validation:** Continue to prominently feature Kore.ai's Leader placements in Gartner and Forrester for Conversational AI for Customer Service in all market-facing materials.
- **Highlight ABL's deterministic advantage:** Emphasize Kore.ai's Agent Behavior Language (ABL) for its compile-time validation and deterministic execution, especially when discussing complex workflows with prospects considering Salesforce Agentforce or Genesys.
- **Reinforce true omnichannel:** Position Kore.ai's unified voice and digital platform as a superior alternative to voice-first or layered CCaaS solutions.
- **Arm sales with TCO clarity:** Equip sales teams with clear messaging and tools to contrast Kore.ai's predictable, outcome-based pricing with the potential overage risks of consumption-based models from competitors like Glean or Salesforce.
